policy: No maturity criterion may be waived for the first stable 1.0 release.

criteria.title: Frozen P1 methodology pilot completed with interpretable comparative signal
Private/fresh P2 confirmatory suite completed and preregistered
Effect replicated across more than one model/agent pairing
External ecological validation completed on selected upstream benchmark families
Operational P4 validation completed for load, soak, rollback and recovery
Assurance burden, cost, false-positive and false-negative analysis completed
Multi-language verification maturity demonstrated for Python and TypeScript
Threat model and software supply chain independently audited with no open critical/high blockers
1.0 governance roles and release authority formally established
